description: On startup, seeds the working rules file from the shipped default unless it already exists. Before every Agent, Skill, Workflow and Bash call, identifies the caller: the main session's Agent calls are checked against the main section and its other calls pass; a fleet subagent's Agent calls are checked against its row in rules, its Skill and Bash calls against the disallowed lists, and its Workflow calls are refused; built-in subagents pass. Separately, an Agent call that targets a fleet agent is refused unless its prompt is a structured brief with the required sections; calls to other agent types are not inspected.
